Gate Configuration: the engineer's path

Today the title carries a ? with a sentence, and the page is two pages. With no loop it shows "Overview · Configuration by loop" (a count sentence "1 of 243 loops run a governed bundle; the rest run the factory layer", a labelled FIND A LOOP field whose placeholder is cut, "243 loop(s)", 20 rows, "← Prev · Page 1 of 13 · Next →"), "Lifecycle · Bundles in progress", Technical details and the Gate role policy card. With a loop it shows three tiles (Effective layer, Profile, Worker alignment), a second Technical details, and tabs Effective | Bundles | Editor; the Gate role policy card repeats under Effective and Bundles. Effective draws the four layers again as cards, then a gate dropdown, Find a property and a 3-column table, then an APPLY acknowledgements disclosure. Bundles adds a callout and a "Draft → Review → Publish" strip over three boxes of version buttons. The Editor is two columns under three rows of tabs (views; Properties | Diff & impact | Shadow; 17 gate chips): a property table whose row expands into an editor, and a lifecycle column (six steps, created / updated / note, "Actions · In order", Approval, Deployments). At 1440 × 900 its first property row is below the fold. On that one screen ACTIVE_VERIFIED is said five times, the bundle hash five times, "This version is ACTIVE_VERIFIED … create a new version to change it." twice and Roll back is offered twice; the lifecycle is drawn three times in three vocabularies. The page answers three questions (what does each loop run under, where does each value of this loop come from, which versions exist at its levels) and holds one task done in order: change a value, validate, shadow, approve, activate, roll back. So two views, Effective and Bundles, each a list with a panel; one bundle opens as tabs in lifecycle order.

Header

What is this page, and how do I read its words?
  • Set up · Gate Configuration, no ?, no sentence
  • Effective | Bundles top right, no counts
  • How to read: Levels, Change class, Flags, Bundle state, Gate roles (today's five ? and the Gate role policy card)

Every loop

What does each loop run under?
  • Effective with no loop: search first (loop, service, profile or unit)
  • Loop (service · unit under it), Profile, Runs under (✓ Active (verified) · LOOP v6 / ○ Factory layer), Effective from · UTC
  • 20 a page, governed first, the shared pager; a row opens the loop
  • Foot: the governed count, Build details

One loop's values

Where does each value come from?
  • The layer strip: FACTORY 57 · PROFILE Flow, fast self-regulating 47 · SITE no bundle · LOOP v6 ✓ Active (verified) 1
  • Property search, then "G4 · Actuator effort · 3 set above factory"
  • Property over its class, Value with its unit, Source
  • Panel: value, source, class, unit, type, factory default, what it does, not read by this build
  • Foot: Workers ✓ 5 of 5 applied → the Workers dialog

Versions

Which versions exist, and which one runs?
  • Bundles: LOOP, PROFILE, SITE grouped in one list, newest first; "no bundle at this level - the layer below applies"
  • Panel: class, created, effective from, validation errors, content hash; Open v6 →
  • Prepare bundle draft: level, note, the version it starts from
  • With no loop: the bundles in progress of the scope

Change it

What do I change, and what does that change?
  • Properties: the same list as Effective plus Flags; the panel is the editor: effective, inherited, bounds, Set, Reset to inherited
  • Diff & impact: affects, rollout, the class sentences, the diff, validation; Validate
  • Next: X → on every tab; the frozen reason once

Prove and release

Is it safe, who approved it, did every worker apply it?
  • Shadow: loop, hours, Run shadow; the report and the reclassification alert
  • Approval: the approvals, then note, valid for (h), Approve
  • Deployments: effective from, Activate, Roll back once; each deployment in a panel with its matrix, probe and semantics

For the owner to decide

  1. Two views, Effective | Bundles, in place of the overview page, the loop page's tiles and the Editor tab? With no loop, Effective lists what every loop runs under and Bundles lists the bundles in progress; with a loop, its values and its levels; a bundle opens under Bundles. Recommended: yes. No backend change.
  2. The governed count as a dropdown: All loops 243 · Governed bundle 1 · Factory layer 242? Adds a filter (client side, no backend change). Recommended: yes; drawn dashed. If not, the count line stays in the list foot as drawn.
  3. The selected property in a panel? On Effective it replaces today's dialog; in a bundle it replaces the row that expands into the editor. Recommended: yes, a drawer below 1280 px. No backend change.
  4. A bundle's lifecycle as five tabs in order, each action on its step's tab? Properties · Diff & impact (Validate) · Shadow (Run shadow) · Approval (Approve) · Deployments (Activate, Roll back), with Next: X →, in place of the always-visible lifecycle column. The other way: keep a lifecycle panel to the right of every tab. Recommended: the tabs. No backend change.
  5. The tabs carry the lifecycle marks (✓ done, ● current) in place of the six-step strip? The marks come from the state, as the strip's do today. Recommended: yes. No backend change.
  6. Prepare bundle draft says which version a draft starts from, and should it start from the active one? Today a draft starts from the newest version of the level by number, whatever its state, and nothing says so: a LOOP draft for FIC10302 starts from v7 (↺ Rolled back, G4.activity_warn_ratio 5), not the active v6 (4.5). Recommended: show "Starts from" (drawn dashed) and start from the level's active version when it has one. Both client side, no backend change.
  7. A confirmation before Roll back? Today it acts on the first click. Adds a step. Recommended: yes; drawn dashed. No backend change.
  8. Gate role policy into How to read? Task 25 put the card under every view of this page; it is the build's reference, the same for every loop. Recommended: How to read › Gate roles, the G9 sentence with it. No backend change.
  9. Diff & impact against the layers below the bundle, not the factory layer only? A first version is compared with FACTORY alone, so the class pack reads as changes: v6 sets one value yet says "36 properties differ from the factory layer" and shows that one as "NO_VALUE → 4.5" where the loop ran 3 (PROFILE); the empty draft FIC10301 v1 says the same. It changes what an approver reads. Client side (the bundle carries its layers; the editor's "inherited" already does this). Recommended: yes. Not drawn: the sample keeps today's 36 rows.

Found on the way, not part of this proposal

  • System Response's "Check G12 settings" opens /cpm/config?loop=…&view=effective&gate=G12, but Effective ignores ?gate= and opens on G0 (checked in a fresh session: the gate dropdown reads G0).
  • Diff & impact of a version with no parent compares with the FACTORY layer only (question 9): 36 "differences" for a bundle that sets one value, and for an empty draft.
  • A new draft starts from the newest version of its level whatever its state: FIC10302's next LOOP draft would carry v7's rolled-back value (question 6).
  • Roll back is offered twice on one screen ("Roll back" in Actions and "Roll back to the previous bundle" on the activation) and acts without a confirmation.
  • The Actions' "Shadow" button only switches to the Shadow tab, where "Run shadow" is the real action.
  • On an active version the Shadow tab says "Validate the bundle first — only a validated bundle can be shadow-run"; it is validated, it is frozen.
  • A bundle id that does not exist shows "Could not load this data · bundle … not found · Retry": the "Bundle not found" state with "‹ Bundles" never shows for the server's 404.
  • Vocabulary: "Draft → Review → Publish" and "until a bundle is published", while no step or action is called Review or Publish (Validate, Shadow, Approve, Activate).
  • The overview says "Active (verified)", "Flow, fast self-regulating", "factory layer"; the loop pages say ACTIVE_VERIFIED, FLOW_FAST_SELF_REG, "Factory layer" for the same facts.
  • Two orders: Effective sorts properties alphabetically, the editor in catalogue order.
  • "rolls back 617f2e13-2ef": a deployment id cut at 12 characters through its hyphen; "epoch —" on every deployment of the lab.
  • "approved by admin (expired)" on the active version: the approval's 2 h validity ran out after activation, and the page still reads it as a warning.
  • The editor shows "catalogue start NO_VALUE" when the catalogue has no start value (the check is !== null; the field is absent). Long names break mid-word ("G0.evidence_retention_day / s").
  • The loop's Technical details stays open when another loop is chosen (the header is not remounted).
  • Lab facts: one governed loop (FIC10302, LOOP v6); no PROFILE or SITE bundle; one draft (FIC10301 v1) that sets nothing; no shadow run, no validation error, nothing waiting for approval or activation, every approval expired. Those states are illustrative in the sample and say so.
